news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹1.24 loss per share (vs ₹0.41 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹1.24 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹0.41 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹129.6m (down 19% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹45.3m (loss widened 203% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 82 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: Royal Cushion Vinyl Products Limited Appoints CS Vikash Mittal as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective March 1, 2026
news.body: Royal Cushion Vinyl Products Limited announced the appointment of CS Vikash Mittal, bearing membership No. FCS 13138, as the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the Company with effect from March 1, 2026. CS Vikash Mittal is a Fellow Company Secretary (FCS) with extensive experience in corporate governance, statutory and regulatory compliance. He has expertise in Companies Act, SEBI regulations, secretarial compliances, Board and shareholder meeting management, regulatory filings, and liaison with ROC and stock exchanges. He is a Law graduate and also holds B.Com (Hons.) qualification with additional experience in GST, taxation, audits, and listed company compliance systems. news.title: Royal Cushion Vinyl Products Limited Announces Resignation of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective January 9, 2026
news.body: Royal Cushion Vinyl Products Limited announced that Mrs. Sarita Khamwani has resigned from the post of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the Company vide her letter dated January 8, 2026 (close of business hours) and will be relieved on January 9, 2026. The resignation was due to personal reasons. The disclosure pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations read with SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/CFD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2023/123 dated July 13, 2023 is enclosed herewith as Annexure - 1. Jayesh Motasha, Director, DIN: 00054236, accepted the resignation and Mrs. Sarita Khamwani will be relieved on close of working hours on January 9, 2026.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.1% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: New major risk - Earnings quality
news.body: The company has a high level of non-cash earnings. Accrual ratio: 36% This is considered a major risk. Non-cash earnings can arise from many different things. However, if a company consistently has a high level of non-cash earnings, it may be a sign that they are recognizing revenue from customers before the full value of the sales are received as cash or they are not depreciating the value of their assets appropriately. These are practices that inflate earnings, while not providing a similar increase to cash flows. Companies in some select industries naturally have a high level of non-cash earnings and it is not a major concern.
